definition: In this historical asylum context, sharpening refers to the act of grinding or shaping ordinary objects such as metal scraps, nails, or wire into pointed, dangerous implements. It is described as a means by which suicidal patients might turn harmless materials into weapons for self-destruction.

reasons: The packet supports sharpening nails, wire, and barrel hoop into deadly instruments, but it does not support the added example of “metal scraps.”
“Grinding or shaping” is not stated in the source; the packet only says these objects were sharpened into deadly instruments.
The definition’s examples include “metal scraps,” which are not stated in the packet (the packet specifies “bits of barrel hoop, … nails and bits of wire”).
